assumptions: Only surface-accepted Baidu paths selected with use_for_baseline are driven; these are planned paths, not observed vehicle trajectories. Surface acceptance does not establish full topology validation.
Roads have one assumed lane, a 30 km/h assumed speed limit, and unregulated junctions; no actual signal timings are supplied.
Vehicle dimensions and car-following parameters are uncalibrated SUMO model assumptions.
Only explicitly observed successive edge connections are permitted, without inferred turns or reverse edges. Internal intersection links are omitted in this technical baseline.
BD-09 coordinates are projected locally for approximate engineering distances without claiming survey-grade geometry.
This run verifies executable integration and conservation only; it is not an independently validated S1 model.
Each selected route receives an assumed vehicle every 60 seconds for the first 1200 seconds; no observed OD flow is used.
